method: Actual SVG documents loaded in the Codex in-app browser; fonts.ready, getBBox, container/diamond containment and within-group text intersection checks.
manual_visual_review: Representative overall and reading views inspected; tree trunk routing, mixed-size line spacing, and tall-canvas reading mode revised from visual findings. Not all pages manually inspected.
limitations: Evidence applies to these four simulated cases on this browser and installed font. It does not certify all inputs, specialist backends, native editors or aesthetic quality.
